# PointCalc

> PointCalc is a tournament toolkit for BGMI, PUBG Mobile and Free Fire organizers. Upload lobby and result screenshots, the app reads placements and kills, then generates the points table, warhead, top fraggers (MVP), slot list, team poster and certificates. Teams can sign up for a tournament from one shared link, and the organizer approves them in the app. Available on iOS and Android with 150K+ downloads. PointCalc Studio is the companion design app: designers and org admins build their own themes from their own artwork and publish them as a link that imports into PointCalc in one tap.

## About

- **Name:** PointCalc (also "Pointcalc | Point Table Maker")
- **Platforms:** Android (Google Play), iOS (App Store)
- **Supported games:** BGMI, PUBG Mobile, Free Fire
- **Flagship feature:** AI screenshot extraction: placements and kills are read directly from lobby/result screens
- **Outputs generated:** Points table, warhead, top fraggers (MVP), slot list, team poster, tournament certificates
- **Founder:** Amal Manoj (public handle: xbeastop), Kerala, India, solo indie developer
- **Founded:** September 2021
- **Team registration:** Organizers share one link; captains sign up in any browser with no app or account; the organizer approves teams, which fill the slots, then splits them into groups
- **Pricing (INR, monthly):** Free tier available; Premium ₹69 (registration up to 50 teams); Organiser Pack ₹200 (up to 1000 teams, team logos, screenshot proof); Premium + AI ₹350; AI Team ₹500 (Premium + AI on up to 5 devices). Weekly, quarterly and yearly plans also exist; new users get a 3-day trial on monthly and longer plans
- **Ratings:** 4.9★ on App Store, 4.4★ on Google Play, 550+ total reviews

## PointCalc Studio

- **What it is:** Companion app for designers and org admins. Open your own background image, place the points table, text, logos, medals and fonts (TTF/OTF), then publish.
- **Design types:** Points table, warhead, top fraggers, slot list, team poster, certificate
- **Sharing:** Every published design is a link (pointcalc.in/d/...). Anyone who opens it in PointCalc imports the design in one tap; no files are passed around.
- **Tools:** AI layout detection from your image, about 25 built-in fonts plus custom TTF/OTF, color picker from the image, preview with sample data or a real tournament, edit a published design and keep the same link
- **Pricing (INR, Google Play):** Free to download; you pay when you publish. One design ₹79 (certificate or table with a top-team block ₹200, own font +₹20), and its link never expires. Studio Pro ₹499/month for unlimited designs; links published on the plan stop working if it ends.
- **Availability:** App Store (https://apps.apple.com/in/app/pointcalc-studio/id6808275729) and Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pointcalc.studio)
- **Page:** https://pointcalc.in/#studio

## Use cases

PointCalc is built specifically for esports tournament/scrim organizers running custom BGMI, PUBG Mobile or Free Fire events. It replaces manual point calculation in spreadsheets and result-graphic editing in Photoshop. Common use cases:

- Daily scrim point tables published after every match
- Tournament finals: winner posters, top fragger of the day, MVP awards, certificates
- Collecting team sign-ups with entry tasks (follows, in-game IDs, payment screenshots) instead of WhatsApp messages or Google Forms
- Slot list / lobby graphics for the start of a tournament day
- Bulk match processing for multi-day events (Premium + AI tier)
- Custom-branded designs for orgs and content creators
